added_audio_observations.notes: Fieldwork January 2026; published 11 March 2026; reviewed 16 November 2026. MEGAFON specifies a web survey through its representative Danmarkspanel and the target as persons over 18 years. The report states demographic weighting. Exact questionnaire routing and detailed weighting variables are unpublished. The explicitly published monthly total is retained directly. Rounded daily, weekly and monthly bars sum to 23%, while the text states 24%. The national sample has 2038 respondents. This measure describes usual listening frequency without a bounded recall period. The 5447-person Mofibo customer survey is outside this extract.

excluded_or_unresolved: The 45% any-frequency total includes less frequent listening. No annual or lifetime interpretation is assigned.
Retrospective 2022 to 2025 any-frequency values are not imported because the original wave designs and age definitions were not separately verified.
Exact favourite genre response rules and the full genre questionnaire are unpublished. Each extracted chart remains a distinct top-five scope.
The age threshold is retained as MEGAFON words it, persons over 18; no numeric cutoff is inferred from the report age-band labels.
The customer survey, age and gender subsets, wellbeing associations and all company audience counts are excluded from these proposals.
